requests.text: My calendar is wall-to-wall client calls and I have no time to think between meetings.
Every month I reconcile supplier invoices from SAP against the contract terms in SharePoint by hand. It takes me about two days.
After every customer call I spend 20 minutes writing notes into Salesforce.
Who can help me give a new analytics team access to Databricks tables without breaking Unity Catalog permissions?
Is there a way to summarise Jira feedback every week?
We drown in feature requests in Jira and need a digest.
How can I clean duplicate customer records safely?
